rows.evidence_for_rfam: none at 13-21; at 22 seed partner marginally closer (C1' 5.6 vs 6.2 A)
rows.evidence_for_star3d: C1' after shared fit: STAR3D partners 0.6-3.2 A vs seed 6.1-8.6 A for 14-21 (same under flank-excluded and local-anchor fits); FR3D within span: canonical cWW 0/7 seed vs 5/7 STAR3D, noncanonical 0/7 vs 2/7, stacks 7/18 vs 10/18 (rfam-vs-STAR3D-forward eligible set); 7REX P1 cWW present in all 3 crystal copies (U1-A22 in 2); the 7REX authors describe P1 as a canonical A-form helix with an A28*G5-C18*A29 triple (G5-C18 = STAR3D register, seed implies G5-C17) (PMC8752633)
rows.confounds_and_limits: STAR3D builds stacks from pairing (partly circular); same 7REX row as r15-22 (one observation); 7REX ligand PRF101 contacts residue 16 and PRF102 contacts 16-18; crystal/ASU contacts at 7REX 21-22 (chain B) and 6VUI 19-23 (symmetry); 6VUI U22-A23 unresolved (both partners ~5-6 A)

rows.evidence_for_rfam: C1' after shared fit: G8 3.4 vs 10.0 A, G11 3.3 vs 8.7 A; seed preserves 3 L1 stacks STAR3D loses (s35 7-8, ns33 8-10, s35 9-10); the seed maps the 6VUI C7-G11 tWH pair onto 7REX C8-A12 (FR3D tWW, different class), the residues the 7REX authors describe as the U32*A12*C8 pocket-ceiling triple (Schroeder et al. 2022, PMC8752633); STAR3D maps it to 7REX 7-13
rows.evidence_for_star3d: C7 3.3 vs 5.3 A, U12 1.3 vs 4.7 A; STAR3D preserves s35 6-7
rows.confounds_and_limits: 7REX L1 residues contact a SECOND preQ1 (PRF101) and Mg (MG103) absent from 6VUI's single site -> genuine structural/ligand-context variation is plausible; crystal contacts at 7REX 8-12; residue-level mixed evidence

rows.evidence_for_star3d: STAR3D partner closer for 7/7 different-partner residues under shared, flank-excluded and local-anchor fits (C1' and base centroid); canonical 0/5 seed vs 5/5 STAR3D, noncanonical 0/5 vs 3/5, stacks 4/9 vs 9/9; same published G5-C18 description of 7REX P1
rows.confounds_and_limits: not independent of r7-23 (same 7REX row); STAR3D pairing circularity; ligand contacts at 7REX 16-18

rows.evidence_for_rfam: G11 seed partner 3.8 vs 10.3 A (shared fit); seed preserves 1 of 4 eligible stacks vs 0
rows.confounds_and_limits: 3FU2 C12 has only P/O5' (no C1'), U13-A14 unobserved; STAR3D's parser treats 3FU2 12 and 15 as sequence neighbours (STAR3D audit); 7REX L1 contacts second preQ1; canonical eligible 0/2 for both

rows.evidence_for_star3d: A33 STAR3D partner 1.9 vs 4.3 A; U32 STAR3D-only (1.3 A)
rows.confounds_and_limits: 3' end of crystallised constructs; Ca2+ and crystal-symmetry contacts at 3FU2 33-34; 1 canonical eligible preserved by neither

rows.evidence_for_star3d: A33: C1' favours STAR3D (4.5 vs 5.7 A) but base centroid favours the seed (4.0 vs 4.9 A); U32 STAR3D-only
rows.confounds_and_limits: terminal; STAR3D forward and reverse disagree here (1 of 3 positions identical) -> direction-unstable STAR3D output; Mn2+/Ca2+ and symmetry contacts

rows.evidence_for_rfam: U24 seed partner 4.9 vs 6.2 A (C1'); A23 base centroid favours seed
rows.confounds_and_limits: 3FU2 A23 contacts another chain in the asymmetric unit and symmetry mates; mixed C1' vs base-centroid evidence; 2 eligible stacks preserved by neither

rows.evidence_for_star3d: C8 STAR3D partner 6.9 vs 8.7 A (both far); U7 STAR3D-only 3.0 A
rows.confounds_and_limits: both partners poorly superposed; 3FU2 C8 forms a non-canonical C-A WWc pair with A34 in STAR3D's raw structure (removed before stacks)
3FU2 13-14 unobserved; STAR3D treats 12 and 15 as neighbours, so its local loop scoring here spans a coordinate gap
